Monorepo support, a safer ledger and fewer false alarms. Found by a code review and a read-only run of get-found on a live Next.js monorepo.

- **Monorepos:** `.get-found/` sits at the repo root and is found from any app folder. `state.py init --app-dir apps/web` records which app is the website.
- **Safer ledger:** a partial or truncated audit can no longer mark site-wide items as passing; reports for another host are refused; off-site steps are not lost when the on-site half fails.
- **First check is read-only:** `/get-found check` before setup writes nothing to your repo.
- **Crawler follows robots.txt** and treats a 5xx robots.txt as disallow-all, as Google does. BOM, missing `</head>` and SVG `<title>` no longer cause false results.
- **IndexNow per host:** apex and www are submitted separately, and failures are loud.
- **Live-doc changes stick** until reviewed (`rules.py ack`), and failed fetches are retried instead of marked fresh.
- New checks: sitemap `lastmod` vs `dateModified`, WebP/AVIF og:images, redirect chains, Google DNS TXT verification. Pages that are noindex on purpose can be listed as `intentional_noindex`.

Full list in CHANGELOG.md.

Install/upgrade: `/plugin marketplace update get-found` in Claude Code, or download `get-found.zip` below for Claude.ai.
